title: Core Group Operational Value Open Base Schema
description: Foundation schema defining properties for core group operational value data.

affiliation.title: Affiliation
affiliation.description: Affiliation name or code associated with the group.

npi.title: National Provider Identifier
npi.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the group. The NPI is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to healthcare providers by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the group or healthcare organization.

tin.title: TIN
tin.description: The Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the group. This is typically an Employer Identification Number (EIN) issued by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

type.title: Type
type.description: The type or classification of the group (e.g., 'Multi-specialty', 'Single-specialty', 'Hospital', etc.).

legalTaxName.title: Legal Tax Name
legalTaxName.description: The legal tax name of the group as registered with tax authorities. This is the official name used for tax reporting purposes.

active.title: Active
active.description: Indicates whether the group is currently active and operational. Inactive groups are typically those that have been terminated or are no longer providing services.

telemedicineAvailable.title: Telemedicine Available
telemedicineAvailable.description: Indicates whether the group offers telemedicine services. When true, the group provides remote healthcare services via telecommunications technology.

taxInfo.description: Represents the legal tax entity information associated with the group, including legal tax name, tax entity states, and references to IRS documentation files.

bedCount.title: Bed Count
bedCount.description: The number of beds available at the group's facility. This is typically relevant for hospitals, nursing homes, and other inpatient facilities.

dea.title: DEA
dea.description: The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) registration number. This is required for healthcare providers who prescribe, dispense, or handle controlled substances.
